messages:
mariam: quick async standup — BrightArc renewal next week, wanted to surface adoption blockers and ask for a quick eng check.

mariam: what I did: ran a health check on their ingestion pipeline, updated the renewal playbook, contacted account exec for pricing opt-ins.

mariam: blockers: BrightArc still seeing embedding drift on new model; ~8% of similarity queries failing threshold, and a webhook retry storm yesterday caused ~10% drop in inference throughput for that org.

sam: noted — I filed a support ticket (SR-4721) and attached logs. I also asked BrightArc to route traffic to the fallback model. They confirmed fallback enabled at 14:30. :white_check_mark:

sam: logs snippet: ```
ERROR 2026-02-10T14:22:11Z: upstream 504: kv-cache timeout, region-us-west-2
POST /v1/embeddings 504
```

jeremy: pinging eng infra — will look at the KV cache evictions and autoscale policy for that customer pool. Can you paste the customer org id?

mariam: org id: BA-7732. Also saw this in their tracing: `model-variant: redwood-small-q4` — might need to route to quantized variant with larger mem.

jeremy: thanks. I'll check node saturation and queue times. If evictions spike we can bump pod_count to 4 for that pool temporarily. Planning to dig in at 15:00 PT.

ana: (PM) — for renewal: we promised a perf improvement plan in the renewal docs. If it's a config change (autoscale/pin), can eng estimate lift and risk by EOD? Customer exec wants a one-pager.

jeremy: estimate: low risk for temporary pod bump + KV cache TTL tweak. Risk: small cost bump and potential cold-start latency. I can draft numbers once I confirm current P50/P95.

mariam: thanks. sam, can you send the embed test set so eng can run a quick eval? I want confirmation that routing to quantized variant doesn't regress quality.

sam: uploading test set to /shared/brightarc/embeddings_eval_2026.csv now. Headline metrics in ticket.

deploy-bot: automated note: Canary rollback triggered for model redwood-small-q4 at 2026-02-10T14:40:02Z due to increased 5xx rate for BA-7732.

jeremy: saw the bot alert. rolling logs now. If we need to force route to `redwood-small-q4-quant` I can patch routing table and notify ops.

mariam: action items —
- sam: confirm test set delivery + any sample failing queries (today, EOD)
- jeremy: check node saturation, propose pod_count + TTL change (by EOD)
- ana: assemble the renewal one-pager with perf plan and risk callout (tomorrow AM)
- sam/mariam: coordinate with account exec for messaging

ana: noted. I'll slot the one-pager into renewal doc and loop in sales.

sam: quick Q for eng — is there an easy toggle we can use for routing just this org to the quantized variant without a full rollout? could save time.

jeremy: yes — we have per-org routing overrides. I can apply override for BA-7732 after tests. Will post confirmation here when done.

mariam: awesome. no other blockers from CSside. if eng wants a short call, I can be free at 16:00 PT. otherwise we'll continue async. :coffee:

jeremy: if I hit anything tricky I'll ping for the 16:00 slot. otherwise I'll update this thread with findings.

sam: thanks all — keeping this thread as single source. updated ticket SR-4721 with test set link and current metrics.

mariam: thanks team — appreciate quick responses. :pray:
